Committee: Governmental Affairs
Sponsor: Givhan
Analyst: John Friedenreich
Date: 02/07/2022
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 135 as introduced exempts examiners employed by the Alabama Credit Union Administration from existing expense allowances provided to State Officers and employees while traveling on state business and allows them to be reimbursed for expenses incurred according to internal polices adopted by the Administration, as authorized pursuant to the provisions of this bill. This could increase the financial obligations of the Alabama Credit Union Administration Fund by an undetermined amount that would be equal to the difference in the amount examiners are currently reimbursed for and the amounts they would be reimbursed under the new policies adopted by the Administration. For fiscal years 2020 and 2021, in-state travel expenses for the Administration were $72,304 and $61,856, respectively.
Jimmy Holley, Chairperson
Governmental Affairs

Committee: State Government
Sponsor: Givhan
Analyst: John Friedenreich
Date: 02/22/2022
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 135 as passed the Senate  (1) exempts examiners employed by the Alabama Credit Union Administration from the travel expense allowances currently provided to State Officers and employees while traveling on state business; and (2) allows these examiners to be reimbursed for travel expenses according to internal polices adopted by the Administration, as authorized pursuant to the provisions of this bill. This bill could increase or decrease the financial obligations of the Alabama Credit Union Administration Fund by an undetermined amount dependent on the difference in the amount examiners are currently reimbursed and the amounts they would be reimbursed under the new policies adopted by the Administration. For fiscal years 2020 and 2021, in-state travel expenses for the Administration were $72,304 and $61,856, respectively.
Chris Pringle, Chair
State Government
